decision: code-reviewed; runtime CI and performance results pending
mechanism: Fresh STATX_MNT_ID via AT_EMPTY_PATH on original held FD; exact existing fdinfo fallback for unsupported/denied syscall. No caching or identity substitution.
verified: Both kernel sources return legacy real_mount(file->f_path.mnt)->mnt_id.
Mask and nonzero ID required; no UNIQUE mount ID.
Unexpected EBADF/EIO/EFAULT/ENOENT refuse; expected unsupported/denied errors require full original fdinfo proof.
Tests cover same FD rebind via Dup3, same inode/dev but different mount ID, fallback parity, cancellation, hard errors.
Old-kernel closed-FD test now requires rejection rather than unavailable-syscall EBADF cause.
limitations: No Go build executed on storage-constrained host.
Native bindmount and race checks pending CI.
Linux4.9 compatibility is designed fallback; physical-router acceptance remains separate.
Primitive forced-fallback measurement excludes failed actual syscall overhead.
